description: Backend Session Flow State Machine and new Tauri commands. Add session flow controller that drives states (IDLE -> FOLDER_SELECTED -> LEADER_CHOSEN -> PLANNING -> PLAN_APPROVED -> EXECUTING -> REVIEWING -> COMPLETE), new Tauri commands for the UI flow (get_adapters, select_folder, choose_leader, send_to_leader, approve_plan, get_session_flow_state), and Leader-as-CLI interaction wiring.
steps: Step 1: Add SessionPhase enum and SessionFlow struct to synergy-proto/src/lib.rs. The enum: Idle, FolderSelected, LeaderChosen, Planning, PlanApproved, Executing, Reviewing, Complete. SessionFlow struct holds: phase, project_dir (Option<String>), leader_adapter_id (Option<String>), plan_text (Option<String>), parsed_tasks (Vec<TaskDraft summary>). Derive Serialize/Deserialize/Clone/Debug.

Step 2: Create a new module crates/synergy-core/src/session_flow.rs that manages the session flow state machine. SessionFlowController struct holds the current SessionFlow, orchestrator reference, and leader handle. Methods: select_folder(path) -> advances to FolderSelected, choose_leader(adapter_id) -> spawns leader process/prepares API, advances to LeaderChosen, send_to_leader(message) -> sends user message to leader via PTY/API, returns response, advance to Planning, approve_plan(plan_text) -> parses plan into tasks, inserts into DB, spawns workers, advances to Executing, check_completion() -> checks if all tasks done, advances to Reviewing/Complete. Export the module from synergy-core/src/lib.rs.

Step 3: Implement Leader interaction in session_flow.rs. For CLI-based leaders (opencode, aider, claude-cli, codex-cli): spawn a PTY process using the adapter's launch method, send user messages via send_command, read responses via read_output with async polling. For API-direct leaders: use the DirectApiAdapter. Store the leader's AppHandle in the SessionFlowController. When leader responds with a plan (detected via leader::parse_plan returning non-empty), store the plan text and parsed drafts.

Step 4: Add leader output streaming. When the leader produces output (reading from PTY), emit a Tauri event 'leader-output' with the text chunk. The UI subscribes to this for real-time display of Leader's responses. Implement a leader_output_pump similar to the existing spawn_output_pump for workers.

Step 5: Add new Tauri commands in synergy-ui/src/lib.rs: (a) get_adapters() -> reads adapters.toml (bundled or from config dir) and returns Vec<AdapterInfo> with id, type, bin, desc fields. (b) select_folder(path: String) -> validates the path exists, stores in session flow, returns Ok. (c) choose_leader(adapter_id: String, project_dir: String) -> initializes the leader (spawns PTY or prepares API), creates DB session, advances flow state. (d) send_to_leader(message: String) -> sends message to leader process, returns immediately (response comes via event). (e) approve_plan(session_id: String, plan_text: String) -> calls add_plan logic, spawns workers, starts orchestrator tick loop. (f) get_session_flow_state() -> returns current SessionFlow for UI to query.
Step 6: Update AppState in synergy-ui/src/lib.rs to include the SessionFlowController (wrapped in Arc<Mutex<>>). Update register_handlers to include all new commands.

Step 7: Add AdapterInfo struct (id, adapter_type, bin, desc) with Serialize. Implement adapter loading from the adapters.toml file. The adapters.toml file is at the project root - for the Tauri app it should be bundled as a resource or read from the executable directory. Use include_str! to embed it at compile time, or read from a known path.

Step 8: Wire the approve_plan flow: when user approves, parse the stored plan text using leader::parse_plan and leader::infer_dependencies, convert to Tasks via leader::drafts_to_tasks, insert all tasks into DB, spawn workers using the orchestrator, start the tick loop. After all tasks complete (detected via polling or event), compose batch report via leader::compose_batch_report and send to leader for review.

Step 9: Implement the review/complete cycle: after batch report is sent to Leader, monitor Leader's response. If leader::is_approval returns true, advance to Complete phase. If not, parse corrections and handle re-assignment (for now, just log and advance to Complete).
Step 10: Add 'session-state-changed' Tauri event emission whenever the session flow phase changes. This allows the frontend to reactively update without polling.
acceptance_criteria: SessionPhase enum exists in synergy-proto with all states
SessionFlowController in synergy-core manages state transitions
New Tauri commands (get_adapters, select_folder, choose_leader, send_to_leader, approve_plan, get_session_flow_state) are defined and registered
Leader PTY interaction works: spawn leader CLI, send messages, stream output via events
approve_plan correctly parses plan, creates tasks, spawns workers, and starts orchestration
Batch report is composed and sent to leader when all tasks complete
Session flow state is queryable by the frontend
adapters.toml content is loadable and returned as structured data
verification: Verify synergy-proto/src/lib.rs contains SessionPhase enum and SessionFlow struct with correct derives
Verify synergy-core/src/session_flow.rs exists with SessionFlowController and all state transition methods
Verify synergy-core/src/lib.rs exports the session_flow module
Verify synergy-ui/src/lib.rs contains all new #[tauri::command] functions and they are in the generate_handler! list
Verify the new commands follow the same patterns as existing commands (async, State<AppState>, Result<T, String>)
findings: Implemented all 10 steps. SessionPhase enum (8 states) in synergy-proto. SessionFlowController in synergy-core/session_flow.rs with methods for each state transition plus send_to_leader and read_leader_output for Leader PTY interaction. Six new Tauri commands added to synergy-ui/src/lib.rs and registered in generate_handler!. AppState extended with session_flow: Arc<Mutex<SessionFlowController>>. adapters.toml embedded via include_str!("../../../adapters.toml"). Leader output pump (spawn_leader_output_pump_tauri) emits 'leader-output' events at 100ms intervals. Completion monitor (spawn_completion_monitor) polls at 1s, composes batch report via leader::compose_batch_report, and sends to leader on completion. The toml crate (0.8, already in Cargo.lock) added to synergy-ui deps for parsing adapters. The pick_adapter function handles all adapter types: opencode direct, cursor/kiro via specific adapters, api-direct via DirectApiAdapter, and all others via GenericCliAdapter (covers aider, claude-cli, codex-cli, etc.). Cannot compile due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode but code follows existing patterns exactly.
